events.description: Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat: one person (in dark clothing and beanie) is attacked from above by another who drops down onto them, leading to a struggle where the attacker appears to grapple or strike the victim.
Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat on a narrow staircase; one attacks from above while the other defends and counters, involving grappling and forceful movement.
One individual is on the ground, subdued and helpless, while another stands over them and delivers repeated strikes to the head/face area; the victim shows signs of distress and inability to defend.

Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat in a narrow corridor: one person (in dark clothing) is seen striking and overpowering another, who is pushed against the wall and then falls to the ground.
After the opponent is on the ground, the attacker continues to assault the helpless victim by kneeling over them and delivering repeated strikes to the head/face area.

A separate scene shows multiple figures in mid-air motion within a large chamber, suggesting a chaotic physical confrontation or escape involving jumping/falling; however, due to low resolution and ambiguity, this is classified as Fighting with moderate confidence.
